rationale: Price is at 99.9% of today's range, essentially at the session high after a 14.7% gap-up on strong earnings, with the last few 1-minute candles showing stalling volume and a slight pullback from the high — classic exhaustion at resistance with no clean continuation signal. A long here risks buying the very top of an extended move with minimal reward-to-risk, while a short against a strong earnings catalyst and upward momentum is equally dangerous. With 175 minutes remaining and the stock already far extended from VWAP ($82.97), the asymmetric risk in either direction does not justify entry.
